reasoning_content: The build is starting but not completing. Let me check if there's a gradle daemon running and check more thoroughly.

python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
c = paramiko.SSHClient()
c.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
c.connect('46.202.154.25', 22, 'root', '2N00py123+++')

# Kill any existing gradle and run with info
c.exec_command("pkill -f gradle || true")

# Run directly with output
c.exec_command("""export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64
export ANDROID_HOME=~/android-sdk
export PATH=/opt/gradle-8.5/bin:\$JAVA_HOME/bin:\$PATH
cd /opt/areloria/client/android
/opt/gradle-8.5/bin/gradle --info assembleDebug 2>&1 | tee /tmp/gradle_build.log | tail -50""")

# Check result
stdin, stdout, stderr = c.exec_command("tail -50 /tmp/gradle_build.log")
print("Log:", stdout.read().decode())

c.close()
EOF
